operators.name: multihead_attention_forward

items.layout: strided, stride [E, H*E, 1] (non-contiguous due to transpose)

semantics: Splits combined projection weight and bias into q_proj_weight, k_proj_weight, v_proj_weight (each [E,E]) and corresponding biases
Projects query, key, value: q = query @ q_proj_weight.T + q_proj_bias, k = key @ k_proj_weight.T + k_proj_bias, v = value @ v_proj_weight.T + v_proj_bias
Reshapes to [B, L, num_heads, head_dim] and transposes to [B, num_heads, L, head_dim] for q,k,v; head_dim = E // num_heads
Scales q by 1/sqrt(head_dim)
Computes attn_logits = q @ k.transpose(-2,-1) (batch matmul) -> [B, num_heads, L, S]
Applies softmax over dim=-1 to attn_logits, yielding attn_weights
Computes attn_output = attn_weights @ v -> [B, num_heads, L, head_dim]
Transposes attn_output to [B, L, num_heads, head_dim] and reshapes to [B, L, E]
Applies output projection: x = attn_output @ out_proj_weight.T + out_proj_bias, preserving the non-contiguous strides as in the reference
Returns tuple (x, attn_weights); attn_weights is contiguous [B, L, S], x may be non-contiguous [B, L, E] with stride [E, H*E, 1] as observed

operators.name: batched_matmul

parameters.name: b
parameters.shape: [B, S, E] but transposed view [B, E, S]

semantics: Performs batched matrix multiplication: out[b] = a[b] @ b_transposed[b], where b_transposed = b.transpose(1,2)
a is the attention output x with shape [B, L, E] and stride [E, H*E, 1]; b is value.transpose(1,2), a non-contiguous view of value [B, S, E] viewed as [B, E, S]
Output shape [B, L, S] = [32,1024,1024]
Uses cuBLAS-like batched GEMM internally; output is contiguous
Executes nn.MultiheadAttention with default parameters: no key_padding_mask, no attn_mask, need_weights=True, average_attn_weights=True, is_causal=False
Model not in training, so dropout is inactive (dropout=0.0)
Returns tuple (attn_output, attn_output_weights)
attn_output shape [32,1024,128], dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride [128,4096,1] indicating a transpose that causes non-contiguity
attn_output_weights shape [32,1024,1024], contiguous
x is the attn_output from step_001, shape [32,1024,128], non-contiguous
value.transpose(1,2) is a view of value with shape [32,128,1024], stride [131072,1,128]
torch.matmul performs batched matrix multiplication, resulting in shape [32,1024,1024]
Output dtype float32, device cuda:0, contiguous
